messages:
julia: quick sync on the API key management UI — dropping notes from the design review. main areas: revoke vs rotate affordance, slide-over button hierarchy, empty state wording, show-secret accessibility. figma link in the doc. mike: agree we should nudge rotate as the safer default but ops want revoke easier to find. what's the tradeoff? julia: rotate as primary keeps users on a safer path (regen new token) but revoke must be prominent and red. proposal: primary = Rotate (solid), danger = Revoke (text-button with red color and icon). aisha: add a one-line helper under permissions: "Rotation preserves scopes (Admin, Read, Embed-only)" — users keep asking if scopes change. mike: backend already preserves scopes on rotate; we can surface that exact string. dan: accessibility issues: 1) the show-secret control lacks descriptive aria label and doesn't announce state. 2) hint copy under key name is low contrast at 12px. julia: update aria label to: "Show API secret (reveals sensitive key)" and add an aria-live region that says "API secret revealed" when toggled. increase hint to 14px and use token color-strong. mike: implementation note: use aria-controls and aria-expanded on the toggle, and a polite aria-live for the secret reveal. snippet: ```html
``` aisha: modal copy for revoke needs clearer consequences. current "Are you sure?" doesn't cut it. suggestion: "Revoking this key will immediately block any services using it. This action cannot be undone." Primary action: Cancel. Danger: Revoke key. dan: modal accessibility: make sure revoke button has aria-describedby pointing to the consequence paragraph. trap focus and support escape. \mjulia: empty state copy discussion: CTA options were "Create your first key" vs "Add API key". data shows new users search "create" often. propose keeping "Create your first key" for empty state and use "Add" as the inline action label for power flows. \maisha: sounds good. propose subcopy: "API keys allow your services and scripts to call the Redwood API securely." (more explicit than current). \dmike: copy-to-clipboard: set aria-label to "Copy secret to clipboard" and show a toast with text "Copied API key" using role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce it. \dan: toasts: polite for success, assertive for errors. ensure focus isn't stolen. \mjulia: rotation flow shows a one-time secret panel — microcopy must be explicit: "This is the new secret. You will not be able to see it again. Copy now and store it in a secrets manager." add a small line: "Redwood will not retain this value." \maisha: legal asked for that exact phrasing. also propose optional tiny link: "Download .env" next to copy (default is copy only). \mdan: if .env download is offered, make it a client-side blob download only. also ensure the copy button uses an accessible label and the file name is predictable e.g., redwood-api-key.env. mike: technical follow-up: when rotating, we can return the secret in the response body once; client handles display/copy/download. we'll add the copy toast behavior and aria-live. julia: action items: I'll update figma with revised modal and empty state copy. mike will implement aria-live announcements and copy-to-clipboard toasts. dan will run a focused a11y pass on the components and checklist focus trap/escape on the modal. aisha will consolidate final copy and run it by legal. maisha: i'll post final suggested strings by EOD. julia: thanks everyone — i'll paste the new copy snippets here after updating figma. :sparkles:
